title: File Selector: Enter Key Prevents Message Submission
body:
**Bug Description**
after using the @-file-selector, if you try to hit "Enter" to submit your message, it's assuming you're trying to press "Enter" on the selected file. Maybe on "Enter" of a selected file can complete that file path in the message and append a space so on any subsequent "Enter"s it will submit the message as expected

**Environment Info**
- Platform: macos
- Terminal: WarpTerminal
- Version: 0.2.76
- Feedback ID: d01081d7-f36a-4764-bb2c-7cd7e10c2b65
author: kevnk
